title: Towns played on the Rabbit Foot show, never Mobile
summary: Asked about Mobile, Mason lists Alabama, Mississippi and Louisiana towns he played but never Mobile.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you, uh... Were you in Mobile?

No, no. I never... I never got to Mobile. That is, I, uh... I passed through there once... On a train... But as far as staying there... I never did even play there... When I was even on the show... We played quite a few times in Alabama, though... Like Sheffield... And... And, uh... Montgomery... And Selma... Birmingham... But, uh... Never in Mobile... Played Biloxi, Mississippi... And... And, uh... A whole lot of those... Gulfport...
A lot of towns in Louisiana... Shreesport... 된... Alexander...
